a: Metiv rav shimi bar abba: im haya kohen, yizrok alav dam chattato vedam ashamo.
Dam chattato shel metzora vedam ashamo shel metzora. dichtiv: "zot tihye torat hammetzora", ben gadol uven katan.
Tenan: hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash, mezidin — chayyayvin. ha shoggin — peturin, ella sheppiggulan piggul.
I amrat bishlama sheluche dishmayya havu, hayeynu sheppiggulan piggul. ella i amrat sheluche didan havu, ammay piggulan piggul? lema leh: shelicha shavvetaych letakkone vela leauote!
Amri: shane gabbe piggul, deamar kera "lo yechashev lo", mikkol makom.

Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol tzerichin daat chutz mimmechussar kappara, shehare adam mevi korban al banav veal benotav hakketannim. ella meatta yavi adam chattat chelev al chavero, shekken adam mevi al ishto shota, kerabbi yehuda. allema amar rabbi elazar: hifrish chattat chelev al chavero — lo asa kelum!
Ishto shota hechi dame? i deachla keshehi shota — lav bat korban hi.

Vei deachla keshehi pikkachat, venishtattet — ha amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, venishtatta vechazar venishtappa — pasul, hoil venidcha — yiddache.
Ella meatta yavi adam pesach al chavero, shekken adam mevi al banav veal benotav hakketannim. allema amar rabbi elazar hifrish pesach al chavero lo asa kelum!
Amar rabbi zera: "se levet avot" lav deorayyta.

Umimmay — midditnan: haomer levanav: hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim, kevan shehichnis rishon rosho verubbo — zacha bechelko, umezakke et echav immo. vei amrat "se levet" deorayyta, al bisra kae umezakke lehu?!
Ella lema lehu deamar lehon avuhon? kede lezarzan bemitzvot. tanya name hachi: maase haya vekadmu banot labbanim, venimtzeu banot zerizot uvanim shefalim.
Vetorem et terumato kulei.
b: Ibbaya lehu: hattorem mishshello al shel chavero, tzarich dato o la? mi amrinan: kevan dizchut hu lo, lo tzarich daat. o dilma mitzva dileh hi, venicha leh lemibedeh.
Ta shema: torem et terumotav veet maserotav ledato. bemay askinan? ilema min baal hakkeri al shel baal hakkeri, uledato deman? illema ledato dileh — man shavvevye shaliach?

Ella ledato devaal hakkeri. ha kamhanne leh dekaaved shelichuteh! ella mishshello al shel hakkeri. uledato deman? ilema ledato devaal hakkeri — ha kamhanne leh! ella lav, ledateh denafsheh, umishshello torem al shel chavero. vei amrat tzarich daat — ha kamhanne leh! ella lav, en tzarich daat.
Leolam mishshel baal hakkeri al baal hakkeri, kidamar rava: beomer "kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom", hacha name beomer vechulei.

Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: hattorem mishshello al shel chavero, tovat hanaa shel mi? mi amrinan: i lav pere dehaych, mi mittakkena karya dehahu, o dilma: i lav karya dehahu, la havyayn pere dehaden teruma?
Amar leh, amar kera: "et kol tevuat zarecha ... venatatta".

Etiveh: torem et terumotav veet maserotav ledato. vei amrat tovat hanaa devaal hakkeri, ha ka mehanne leh! ella shema minna tovat hanaa dileh. amri: lo, mishshel baal hakkeri al shel baal hakkeri, uledato devaal hakkeri, beomer "kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom".
Ta shema, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: hammakdish mosif chomesh, umitkapper — ose temura. vehattorem mishshello al sheeno shello — tovat hanaa shello.

Melammedo midrash halachot veaggadot, aval lo yelammedennu mikra. mikra may tama lo yelammedennu — mishshum dekamhanne leh, midrash name kamhanne leh! amar shemuel: bemakom shennotlin sachar al hammikra veen notlin sachar al hammidrash. may paska?

a: Ha ka mashma lan daafillu bimkom shennotlin sachar, al hammikra shere lemishkal, al hammidrash la shere lemishkal.

May shena midrash dela — dichtiv: "veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem", uchetiv: "ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai", ma ani bechinnam — af attem name bechinnam. mikra name bechinnam!
Rav amar: sechar shimmur. verabbi yochanan amar: sechar pissuk teamim.
Tenan: lo yelammedennu mikra. bishlama leman deamar sechar pissuk teamim — hayeynu dela yelammedennu, ella leman deamar sechar shimmur — gadol bar shimmur hu? bekatan katane.
I bekatan, ema sefa: aval melammed et banav mikra, katan bar banim hu?! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: lo yelammedennu mikra — bekatan, im haya gadol — melammedo lo ulevanav mikra.

Metivi: tinokot lo korin battechilla bashshabbat, ella shonin barishon. bishlama leman deamar sechar pissuk teamim — hayeynu deen korin battechilla bashshabbat. ella leman deamar sechar shimmur, ammay en korin battechilla bashshabbat, veammay shonin barishon? ha ikka sechar shimmur deshabbat!

Velitamaych sechar pissuk beshabbat mi asur? havelaa hi, vehavelaa mishre shere. detanya: hassocher et happoel lishmor et hattinok, lishmor et happara, lishmor et hazzeraim — en notnin lo sechar shabbat. lefichach
b: Im avdu — eno chayyayv beachrayutan. veim haya sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua — noten lo sechar shabbat. lefichach im avdu — chayyayv beachrayutan.

Ella: gabbe shabbat hayeynu tama deen korin battechilla — mishshum deyifnu avahathon deyanoke lemitzveta deshabbeta. veibbaet ema: mishshum divshabbeta achlin veshatin veyakkir alehon alma. kidamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim.
Uleman deamar sechar pissuk teamim, may tama la amar sechar shimmur? kasavar banot mi ka baayayn shimmur?
Uleman deamar sechar shimmur, may tama la amar sechar pissuk teamim? kasavar (sechar) pissuk teamim deorayyta hu.

Deamar rav ika bar avin amar rav chananel amar rav: may dichtiv "vayyikreu vassefer betorat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu bammikra". "vayyikreu vassefer betorat haelohim" — ze mikra, "meforash" — ze targum, "vesom sechel" — ellu happesukim, "vayyavinu bammikra" — ze pissuk teamim. veamri la: ellu hammesorot.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: mikra sofrim, veittur sofrim, vekaryayn vela ketivan, uchetivan vela karyayn — halacha lemoshe missinay.
Mikra sofrim: aretz, shamayim, mitzrayim.
Ittur sofrim: "achar taavoru", "achar telech", "achar teasef", "kiddemu sharim achar nognim", "tzidkatcha keharere el".

Karyayn vela ketivan: "perat" divlechto", "ish" dechaasher yishal ish bidvar haelohim", "baim" denivneta", "lah" difleta", "et" "dehugged huggad", "elay" dehaggoren", "elay" dehasseorim", halen karyayn vela ketivan.
Uchetivan vela karyayn: "na deyislach",

a: "Zot" "dehammitzva", "yidroch" dehaddorech", "chamesh" difat negev", "im" dechi goel" — halen ketivan vela karyayn.
Amar rav acha bar adda: bemareva paskin lehaden pesuka litlata pesukin: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan".
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: lo heeshir moshe ella mippesoltan shel luchot, shenneemar: "pesol lecha shene luchot avanim karishonim" — pesoltan shellecha yehe.

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lo nittena tora ella lemoshe ulezaro, shenneemar: "ketov lecha", "pesol lecha": ma pesoltan shellecha — af ketavan shellecha. moshe nahag bah tovat ayin unetanah leyisrael, vealav hakkatuv omer: "tov ayin hu yevorach vegomer".
Metiv rav chisda: "veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem" — veoti tzivva, vaani lachem. "ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay" — oti tzivva, vaani lachem.
"Veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira hazzot", hashshira lechudda. "lemaan tihye li hashshira hazzot leed bivne yisrael"! ella, pilpula bealma.

Amar rabbi yochanan: en hakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato ella al gibbor veashir vechacham veanav, vechullan mimmoshe. gibbor, dichtiv: "vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan", veamar mar: moshe rabbenu peraso, uchetiv: "eser ammot orech hakkaresh vegomer". ema daarich vekattin!
Ella min haden kera, dichtiv: "vaetpos bishne halluchot vaashlichem meal shete yaday vaashabberem", vetanya: halluchot orkan shishsha verochban shishsha veovyayn shelosha.

Ashir — "pesol lach", pesoltan shellecha yehe. chacham — rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: chamishshim shaare vina nivreu baolam, vechullam nittenu lemoshe chaser achat, shenneemar: "vattechasserehu meat meelohim". anav — dichtiv: "vehaish moshe anav meod".
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim ashirim hayu, menalan — mimmoshe umishshemuel meamos umiyyona.
Moshe — dichtiv: "lo chamor echad mehem nasati". i bela agra, leappoke man deshakel bela agra? ella daafillu beagra. dilma mishshum deani hava. ella min "pesol lach" — pesoltan yehe shellecha.

Shemuel, dichtiv: "hinni anu vi neged Adonai veneged meshicho et shor mi lakachti vachamor mi lakachti". i bechinnam, leappoke man deshakel bechinnam?! ella, daafillu besachar. dilma deani hava, ella mehacha: "uteshuvato haramata ki sham beto", veamar rava: kol makom shehalach — beto immo.

Amar rava: gadol ma shenneemar bishmuel yoter mishshenneemar bemoshe, deillu bemoshe rabbenu ketiv "lo chamor echad mehem nasati", daafillu besachar, veillu gabbe shemuel afillu beratzon lo secharo, dichtiv: "vayyomru lo ashaktanu velo ratztzotanu vegomer".
Amos, dichtiv: "vayyaan amos vayyomer el amatzya lo navi anochi velo ven navi anochi ki voker anochi uvoles shikmim", kedimtargem rav yosef: ari mare gitte ana veshikmin li beshafelta vegomer.
Yona, dichtiv: "vayyitten secharah vayyered bah", veamar rabbi yochanan: shennatan secharah shel sefina kullah. amar rabbi romanus: secharah shel sefina havya arbaat alafim dinare dahava.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: battechilla haya moshe lamed tora umeshakkecha, ad shennittena lo bemattana, shenneemar: "vayyitten el moshe kechalloto ledabber itto".

Mishna vezan et ishto veet banav, af al pi shehu chayyayv bimzonotan. velo yazun et behemto, ben temea ben tehora. rabbi eliezer omer: zan et hattemea, veeno zan et hattehora. amru lo: ma ben temea lithora? amar lehu: shehattehora nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, utemea
b: Nafshah vegufah lashshamayim. amru lo: af hattemea nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, sheim yirtze hare hu mochrah laggoyim o maachilah lakkelavim.

Gemara amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna: hammuddar hanaa mechavero — muttar lehassi lo bitto. have ba rabbi zera: bemay askinan? ilema beshennichse avi challa asurin al hechatan, hare moser lo shifcha leshammesho!
Ella benichse chatan asurin al avi challa. gedola mizzo amru: zan et ishto veet banav, veaf al pi shehu chayyayv bimzonotan, veat amrat muttar lehassi lo bitto?!
Leolam beshennichse avi challa asurin al hechatan, uvevitto bogeret, umiddatah.
Tanya name hachi: hammuddar hanaa mechavero — asur lehassi lo bitto, aval massio bitto bogeret umiddatah.

Amar rabbi yaakov: hammaddir beno letalmud tora — muttar lemalloot lo chavit shel mayim, ulehadlik lo et hanner. rabbi yitzchak amar: litzlot lo dag katan. amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: hammuddar hanaa mechavero — muttar lehashekoto kos shel shalom. may nihu? hacha targimu: kos shel bet haevel. bemareva amri: kos shel bet hammerchatz.

Velo yazun et behemto ben kulei. tanya, yehoshua ish uzza omer: zan avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim, velo yazun et behemto, ben temea ben tehora. may tama? avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim — lemancharuta avidan, behema — lefittuma avida.
Mishna hammuddar hanaa mechavero venichnas levakkero — omed aval lo yoshev. umerappeo refuat nefesh, aval lo refuat mamon.

a: Gemara bemay askinan? i beshennichse mevakker asurin al chole — afillu yoshev name? i beshennichse chole asurin al hamevakker — afillu omed name la! amar shemuel: leolam beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole, uvimkom shennotlin sachar al hayyeshiva, veen notlin sachar al haamida.

May paska? ha ka mashma lan deaf bimkom shennotlin sachar, al hayyeshiva — bae lemishkal, al haamida — la bae lemishkal. veibbaet ema: kidrabbi shimon ben elyakim, gezera shemma yishhe baamida. hacha name gezera shemma yishhe bishiva.
Ulla amar: leolam beshennichse chole asurin al hamevakker, uchegon dela addereh min chayyuteh. i hachi, afillu yoshev name! ha efshar baamida.
Metivi: chala hu — nichnas levakkero, chala beno — shoalo bashshuk. bishlama leulla deamar beshennichse chole asurin al hamevakker, uchegon dela addereh min chayyuteh — shappir.

Ella lishmuel deamar beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole, may shena hu umay shena beno? amar lach: matnitin beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole, barayyta beshennichse chole asurin al hamevakker.
May paska? amar rava: (amar) shemuel
b: Matnitin keshiteh; may irya detane omed aval lo yoshev? shema minna denichse mevakker asurin al hachole.

Amar resh lakish: remez levikkur cholin min hattora minnayin? shenneemar: "im kemot kol haadam yemutun elle ufekuddat kol haadam vegomer". may mashma? amar rava: im kemot kol haadam yemutun elle, shehen cholim umutalim baarisatan, uvene adam mevakkerim otan, ma habberiyyot omrim — "lo Adonai shelachani laze".
Daresh rava: "im beria yivra Adonai", "im beria" gehinnam — mutav tihye, im lav — "yivra Adonai".
Ini? veha tanya: shiva devarim nivreu kodem shennivra haolam, ellu hen: tora, uteshuva, gan eden, vegehinnam, kisse hakkavod, uvet hammikdash, ushemo shel mashiach.
Tora, dichtiv Adonai: "kanani reshit darko vegomer".
Teshuva, dichtiv: "beterem harim yulladu vattecholel vegomer tashev enosh ad dakka vegomer".
Gan eden, dichtiv: "vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem vegomer".
Gehinnam, dichtiv: "ki aruch meetmul tofte".
Kisse kavod, dichtiv: "nachon kisacha meaz".
Bet hammikdash, dichtiv: "kisse chavod marom merishon".
Shemo shel mashiach, dichtiv: "yehi shemo leolam vegomer".
Ella hachi kaamar: i ibberi leh pumma — mutav, veim la — "yivra Adonai". vehachtiv: "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh"! hachi kaamar: i hacha la mekarav pumma — lehacha likrav.

Daresh rava, veamri la amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "shemesh yareach amad zevula". shemesh veyareach bizvul may baayayn? veha berakia kevii! melammed shealu shemesh veyareach merakia lizvul, veamru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, im atta ose din leven amram — anu meirim, veim lav — en anu meirin.

Beotah shaa yara bahen chitztzim vachanitot, amar lahem: bechol yom vayom mishtachavim lachem veattem meirim. bichvodi lo mechitem, bichvod basar vadam mechitem! uvechol yom vayom yorin bahen chitztzin vachanitot umeirim, shenneemar: "leor chitztzecha yehallechu vegomer".

Tanya: bikkur cholim en lah shiur. may "en lah shiur"? savar rav yosef lememar en shiur lemattan secharah. amar leh abbaye: vechol mitzvot mi yesh shiur lemattan secharan? veha tenan: heve zahir bemitzva kalla kevachamura, sheen atta yodea mattan secharan shel mitzvot! ella amar abbaye: afillu gadol etzel katan. rava amar: afillu mea peamim beyom.
Amar rabbi acha bar chanina: kol hamevakker chole, notel echad mishshishshim betzaaro. amri leh: im ken liallun shittin velokmu! amar leh: keissureyayta deve rabbi, uveven gilo.

Detanya rabbi omer: bat hannizonet minnichse achin — notelet issur nechasim. amru lo lerabbi: lidvarecha mi sheyyesh lo eser banot uven, en lo labben bimkom banot kelum! amar lahen: rishona notelet issur nechasim, sheniyya bamme sheshshiyyeyra, shelishit bamme sheshshiyyeyra, vechozrot vecholkot beshave.
Rav chelbo chalash, nefak achrez rav kahana:

a: Rav chelbo beesh. la ikka deka ate. amar lehu: lo kach haya maase betalmid echad mittalmide rabbi akiva shechala. lo nichnesu chachamim levakkero, venichnas rabbi akiva levakkero, uvishvil shekkibbedu veribbetzu lefanav, chaya. amar lo: rabbi, hecheyitani. yatza rabbi akiva vedarash: kol mi sheen mevakker cholim keillu shofech damim.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: kol hamevakker et hachole gorem lo sheyyichye, vechol sheeno mevakker et hachole gorem lo sheyyamut. may gerama? illema kol hamevakker et hachole mevakkesh alav rachamim sheyyichye, vechol sheen mevakker et hachole mevakkesh alav rachamim sheyyamut. sheyyamut salka datach?! ella: kol sheen mevakker chole, en mevakkesh alav rachamim, lo sheyyichye velo sheyyamut.

Rava, yoma kadmaa dechalesh amar lehon: la tigallo leinish, dela littera mazzaleh. mikkan veelach amar lehon: puku veachrizu beshuka, dechol desane li lichde li, uchetiv: "binfol oyivcha al tismach vegomer", uderachem li live alay rachame.

Amar rav: kol hamevakker et hachole nitztzol middinah shel gehinnam, shenneemar: "ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai", en dal ella chole, shenneemar: "middalla yevatztzeeni", i name min haden kera: "maddua atta kacha dal ben hammelech babboker babboker vegomer". en raa ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu vegam rasha leyom raa".
Veim bikker ma secharo? ma secharo?! kidamar: nitztzol middinah shel gehinnam! ella: ma secharo baolam hazze —

"Adonai yishmerehu vichayyehu veushshar baaretz veal tittenehu benefesh oyvav". "Adonai yishmerehu" — miyyetzer hara, "vichayyehu" — min hayyissurin, "veushshar baaretz" — sheyyehu hakkol mitkabbedin bo, "veal tittenehu benefesh oyvav" — sheyyizdammenu lo reim kenaaman sherippu et tzarato, veal yizdammenu lo reim kirchavam shechilleku et malchuto.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im yomru lach yeladim "bene" uzekenim "setor" — shema lazzekenim veal tishma layyeladim. shebbinyan yeladim setira, usetirat zekenim binyan. vesiman laddavar: rechavam ben shelomo.

Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: la lisod inish ketzira la bitlat shae kadmayayta, vela bitlat shae batrayayta deyoma, ki hechi dela layssach dateh min rachame. telat shae kadmayayta — ravvcha dateh. batrayayta — takef chulesheh.

Amar ravin amar rav: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu zan et hachole, shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay vegomer". veamar ravin amar rav: minnayin shehashshechina sheruya lemala mimmittato shel hachole, shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay".

Tanya name hachi: hannichnas levakker et hachole, lo yeshev lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe kisse, ella mitattef veyoshev al gabbe karka, mippene shehashshechina sheruya lemala mimmittato shel chole, shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay".
Veamar ravin amar rav: mitra bemareva — sahada rabba perat. ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: nahra mikkefeh mitbarech. ufeliga dishmuel addishmuel, deamar shemuel: en hammayim metaharin bezochalin
b: Ella perat beyome tishre bilvad.
Avu dishmuel avad lehon mikvoot livnateh beyome nisan, umappatze beyome tishre.
Amar rabbi amme amar rav: may dichtiv "veatta ven adam ase lecha kele gola" — zo ner ukeara

a: Veshatiach. "bechoser kol", amar rabbi amme amar rav: belo ner uvelo shulchan. rav chisda amar: belo ishsha. rav sheshet amar: belo shammash. rav nachman amar: belo dea. tana: belo melach uvelo revav.
Amar abbaye: naktinan — en ani ella bedea. bemareva amri: deda beh — kulla beh, dela da beh — ma beh. da kane — ma chasar, da la kane — ma kane.

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: en hachole omed mecholyo ad shemmochalin lo al kol avonotav, shenneemar: "hassoleach lechol avonechi harofe lechol tachaluaychi". rav hamenuna amar: chozer lime alumav, shenneemar: "rutfash besaro minnoar yashuv lime alumav". "kol mishkavo hafachta vecholyo", amar rav yosef: lomar dimshakkeach talmudo.

Rav yosef chalash, iakkar leh talmudeh, ahdereh abbaye kammeh. hayeynu divchol ducheta amrinan, amar rav yosef: la shemia li hada shemata, amar leh abbaye: at amrita nihalan, umaha matnita amrita nihalan.

Ki hava gemir rabbi telat esre appe hilchata, agmereh lerabbi chiyyay shiva minnehon. lesof chalash rabbi, ahdar rabbi chiyyay kammeh hanhu shiva appe deagmereh, shitta azzedu. hava hahu katztzara, hava shemia leh lerabbi kedahava gares lehu. azal rabbi chiyyay ugemar yathon kamme katztzara vaata veahdar yathon kamme rabbi. kad hava chaze leh rabbi lehahu katztzara amar leh rabbi: atta asita oti veet chiyyay. ikka deamri, hachi kaamar leh: atta asita et chiyyay, vechiyyay asa oti.

Veamar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: gadol nes shennaase lachole yoter min hannes shennaasa lachananya mishael vaazarya. shel chananya mishael vaazarya esh shel hedyot, vehakkol yecholim lechabbotah. vezo shel chole — shel shamayim hi, umi yachol lechabbotah?

Veamar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba veamri la amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kevan shehiggia kitztzo shel adam hakkol moshlim bo, shenneemar: "vehaya chol motzi yahargeni". rav amar min haden kera: "lemishpatecha amdu hayyom ki hakkol avadecha".
Rabba bar shela amaru leh: shechev gavra. gavoah hava, rechiv girdona zutera, meta tittura istevit, shadyeh veka shachev. kare al nafsheh: "lemishpatecha amdu hayyom".
Shemuel chazyay lehahu kerukita deakrabba yetiva al akruketa veavra nahara tarka gavra umayet. kare aleh "lemishpatecha amdu hayyom".

Amar shemuel: en mevakkerin et hachole ella lemi shechalatzattu chamma. leappoke may? leappoke ha detanya, rabbi yose ben perata omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: en mevakkerin lo chole meayim velo chole haayin velo mechushe harosh. bishlama chole meayim — mishshum kissufa. ella chole haayin umechushe harosh may tama?
Mishshum derav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: dibbura kashya leena umealle leishshata. amar rava: hay ishshata, i lav defarvonka demalacha demota, mealle
b: Kechizra ledikle, chad litlatin yomin, vechi tiryayki legufa. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: la hi vela tiryayka.

Amar rabba bar yonatan amar rav yechiel: arsan yafe lachole lirfuato. may arsan? amar rabbi yonatan: chushela disare attikata deresh nafya, amar abbaye: baayayn bishshula keen bisra detora. rav yosef amar: semide disare attikata deresh nafya, amar abbaye: baayayn bishshula kevisra detora.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bordam, en mevakkerim veen mazkirin shemo. may tama? amar rabbi elazar: mippene shehu kemayayn hannovea. veamar rabbi elazar: lamma nikra shemo "bordam" — shehu kemayayn hannovea.

Umerappeehu refuat hannefesh kulei. hechi katane? illema dirfuat nefesh bechinnam, refuat mamon besachar, litne hachi: merappeehu bechinnam, aval lo besachar! ella: refuat nefesh — gufo, refuat mamon — behemto. amar rabbi zutera bar toviyya amar rav: aval omer lo "sam peloni yafe lah, sam peloni ra lah".
Mishna verochetz immo beambati gedola, aval lo biktanna. veyashen immo bammitta.

Rabbi yehuda omer: bimot hachamma, aval lo bimot haggeshamim, mippene shehu mahanehu. umesev immo al hammitta. veochel immo al hashshulechan, aval lo min hattamchuy. aval ochel hu immo min hattamchuy hachozer.

Gemara tanya: lo yirchatz immo beambati, velo yishan immo bammitta, ben gedola ben ketanna, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gedola bimot haggeshamim, uketanna bimot hachamma — muttar. rochetz immo beambati gedola, umazzia immo biktanna. aval mesev immo al hammitta veochel immo al hashshulechan, aval lo min hattamchuy. aval ochel hu min hattamchuy hachozer. amar rabbi yose bar chanina: min hattamchuy hachozer levaal habbayit.
Mishna lo yochal immo min haevus shellifne happoalim, velo yaase immo bauman, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ose vehu barachok mimmennu.
Gemara bekarov la peligi daasir. ki peligi berichuk, rabbi meir savar: gazrinan rachok mishshum karov, deka merappe le leara kammeh. verabbanan savri: la gazrinan.

a: Mishna hammuddar hanaa mechavero lifne sheviit — eno yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min hannotot. uvashsheviit — eno yored letoch sadehu, aval ochel hu min hannetiot hannotot. nadar hemennu maachol, lifne sheviit — yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min happerot, uvashsheviit — yored veochel.

Gemara rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: "nechasim ellu alecha" — lifne sheviit en yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min hannotot, af al pi shehiggia sheviit. veim bashsheviit nadar — en yored letoch sadehu, aval ochel min hannotot.
Verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: "nechasay alecha" — lifne sheviit en yored letoch sadehu veen ochel min hannotot, higgia sheviit — eno yored letoch sadehu, aval ochel hu et hannotot.
Lema beha kamippalgi, derav ushemuel savri: adam oser davar shebbirshuto afillu lichsheyyetze mershuto. verabbi yochanan veresh lakish savri: en adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto.
Vetisbera? mi ikka leman deamar en adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze merashuto? im ken, niflege binchasim ellu", vechol shekken binchasay"!
Vetu, ha tenan deadam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto, ditnan: haomer livno "kuvnnam sheatta nehene li", met — yirashennu. "bechayyav uvemoto",
b: Im met — lo yirashennu! shane hacha deka amar leh "bechayyav uvemoto".
Mikkol makom kashya? ella: binchasim ellu" — kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi binchasay".
Rav ushemuel savri: la shena "nechasim ellu", la shena "nechasay", adam oser. verabbi yochanan veresh lakish savri: "nechasim" — adam oser, "nechasay" — en adam oser.

Umi ikka leman deamar la shena "nechasim ellu" vela shena "nechasay"? veha tenan: haomer lachavero "kuvnnam letoch betcha sheani nichnas", "sadcha sheani lokeach", met o shemmecharo leacher — muttar. "levayit ze sheani nichnas", "sade zo sheani lokeach", met o shemmecharo leacher — asur.
Ella: ki amri rabbi yochanan veresh lakish, binchasay". verav ushemuel, binchasim ellu", vela peligi.
Uvashsheviit en yored letoch sadehu kulei. may shena deochel min hannotot — defere dehefkera innun, ara name afkera?!
Amar ulla: beomdin ilanot al haggevulim. rabbi shimon ben elyakim amar: gezera shemma yishhe baamida.
Mishna hammuddar hanaa mechavero — lo yashilennu velo yishal mimmennu, lo yalvennu velo yilve mimmennu, velo yimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu.

a: Gemara bishlama lo yalvennu — deka mahane leh. ella la yilve hemennu, may ka mahane leh? uvishlama lo yilve hemennu velo yikkach hemennu — dekamithane minneh, ella lo yishal hemennu, may ka mithane minneh!
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kegon shennadru hanaa ze mizze. abbaye amar: gezera lishol mishshum lehasheil, vechen bechullehu gezera.

Mishna amar lo: "hasheileni paratcha". amar lo: enah penuya. amar: "kuvnnam sadi sheani choresh bah leolam". im haya darko lachrosh — hu asur, vechol adam muttarim. veim en darko lachrosh — hu vechol adam asurin.
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, holech etzel hachenvani veomer: ish peloni noder mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese. vehu noten lo, uva venotel mizze.
Haya beto livnot, gedero ligdor, sadehu liktzor, holech etzel happoalim veomer: ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese. vehen osin immo, uvain venotlin sachar mizze.

Hayu mehallechin badderech veen lo ma yochal, noten leechad leshum mattana, vehalla muttar bah. im en immahem acher — manniach al hassela o al haggader veomer: hare hen mufekarim lechol mi sheyyachpotz, vehalla notel veochel. verabbi yose oser.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi yose? kasavar: hefker kemattana. ma mattana — ad deatya mershut noten lirshut mekabbel, af hefker — ad deatya lirshut zoche.
Metiv rabbi abba: vehalla notel veochel, verabbi yose oser. amar rabbi yose: ematay — bizman shennidro kodem lehefkero.
b: Aval im haya hefkero kodem lenidro — hare ze muttar. vei amrat ad deate lirshut zoche, ma li nidro kodem lehefkero, ma li hefkero kodem lenidro?
Hu motev la vehu meshanne la: kol hannoder en dato al ma shehifkir.
Metiv rava: miktzatan larishon vechullan lashsheni — rishon kana,
Sheni lo kana!
Ella amar rava, hayeynu tama derabbi yose: gezera mishshum mattenat bet choron.
Tanya: hammafkir et sadehu, kol shelosha yamim — yachol lachazor bo, mikkan veelach — en yachol lachazor bo.

a: Amar "tehe sade zo mufekeret leyom echad", "leshabbat achat", "lechodesh echad", "leshana achat", "leshavua echat" — ad shello zacha bah, ben hu ben acher yachol lachazor bo. mishshezzacha bah — ben hu ben acher, en yachol lachazor bo. resha rabbanan, sefa rabbi yose!
Amar ulla: sefa name rabbanan hi. i hachi, ammay ad shello zacha bah ben hu ben acher, yachol lachazor bo? shane shana veshavua dela shechichi.
Resh lakish amar: middesefa rabbi yose, resha name rabbi yose. veresha, hayeynu tama — dela lishtakkach torat hefker.
I hachi, afillu miyyom harishon name leheve hefker! amar rabba: mippene harammain, demafkirin vehadrin behon.
Aval deorayyta la have hefker?
b: Vedilma ate leassore min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv.
Deamrinan leh: ki measserat — assar minneh uveh.
Metivi: hammafkir et karmo, velashshachar amad uvetzaro — chayyayv beferet uveolelot uveshichcha uvefea. ufatur min hammaaser.
Bishlama leulla, derabbanan katane la udeorayyta katane la. ella leresh lakish, ammay patur min hammaaser?
Amar lecha: ki amari ana — lerabbi yose, ha — rabbanan hi.

a: Ibbaet ema: ha deafkereh beanpe teren, veha deafkereh beappe telata. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: kol hammafkir bifne shelosha — have hefker, bifne shenayim — la have hefker.
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: devar tora afillu beechad — have hefker, uma taam amru bishlosha, kede sheyyehe echad zoche ushenayim meidin.
Haderan alach en ben hammuddar
b: Hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze — asurin likkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ze nichnas letoch shello, veze nichnas letoch shello.

a: Ushenehem asurim lehaamid rechayim vetannur ulegaddel tarnegolim.

Haya echad mehem muddar hanaa mechavero — lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol hu lomar lo: letoch shelli ani nichnas, veeni nichnas letoch shellecha. vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko.
Haya echad min hashshuk muddar beechad mehem hanaa — lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol lomar lo: letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas, veeni nichnas letoch shellecha.
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veyesh lo merchatz uvet habbad musekarin bair, im yesh lo bahen tefisat yad — asur, en lo bahen tefisat yad — muttar.

Haomer lachavero: "kuvnnam levetcha sheani nichnas, vesadcha sheani lokeach", met o shemmecharo leacher — muttar. "kuvnnam bayit ze sheani nichnas", "sade zo sheani lokeach", met o shemmecharo leacher — asur.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: benadru peligi, hiddiru ze et ze may? mi amrinan: benadru hu difligi, aval behiddiru ze et ze — modu leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov dechi anusin damu. o dilma: afillu behiddiru ze et ze peligi rabbanan?
Ta shema: haya echad mehen muddar hanaa mechavero, ufeligi rabbanan! tane: nadur mechavero hanaa.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko. i amrat bishlama dindar hu, hayeynu dekatane kofin. ella i amrat deaddereh, ammay kofin oto? ha menas anis?
Amar rabba amar zeeri:
b: Machloket sheyyesh bah kede chalukka. aval en bah kede chalukka — divre hakkol muttar.
Amar leh rav yosef: hare bet hakkeneset, dichmi sheen bo kede chalukka dame, utenan: shenehen asurin bedavar shel otah hair!
Ella, amar rav yosef, amar zeeri: machloket sheen bah kede chalukka, aval yesh bah kede chalukka — divre hakkol asur.
Amar rav huna: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. vechen amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.

Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veyesh lo sham merchatz vechulei. vechamma tefisat yad? amar rav nachman: lemechetza lishlish velirvia. aval bivtzir — la. abbaye amar: afillu bivtzir — asur. hechi dame dishre — dimkabbel betaska.

a: Haomer lachavero vechulei. bae avimi: "kuvnnam levayit ze sheatta nichnas", met o shemmecharo leacher, mahu? adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto, o la?

Amar rava, ta shema: haomer livno "kuvnnam shei atta nehene li", umet — yirashennu. "bechayyav uvemoto", umet — lo yirashennu. shema minna adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto. shema minna.
Tenan hatam: "kuvnnam perot haellu alay", "kuvnnam hen al pi", "kuvnnam hen lefi" — asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen.

Bae rame bar chama: amar "kuvnnam perot haellu al peloni", mahu bechillufehen? mi amrinan gabbe dileh, hoil veadam oser perot chavero al atzmo, adam oser davar shello va leolam al atzmo. gabbe chavero, hoil veen adam oser perot chavero al chavero, en adam oser davar shello va leolam al chavero.
b: O dilma mishshum dechillufin kegiddulin dame, la shena hu vela shena chavero.
Amar rav acha bar minyome, ta shema: haomer leishto "kuvnnam sheani nehene lich", lova uvale chovin bain venifrain. may tama bale chovin nifrain — lav mishshum dechillufin lav kegiddulin dame?
Amar rava: dilma lechattechilla hu dela, vei avad — avad.
Ella, ta shema: hamekaddesh beorla — enah mekuddeshet. mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen — hare zo mekuddeshet. hacha name: lechattechilla hu dela, vei avad — avad.
Mishna "hareni alecha cherem" — hammuddar asur. "hare at alay cherem" — hannoder asur. "hareni alecha veat alay" — shenehem asurin, ushenehem muttarin bedavar shel ole bavel,

a: Vaasurim bedavar shel otah hair. veezehu davar shel ole bavel — kegon har habbayit, vehaazarot, vehabbor shebbeemtza hadderech. veezehu davar shel otah hair — kegon harchava, vehammerchatz, uvet hakkeneset, vehatteva, vehassefarim. vehakkotev chelko lannasi.

Rabbi yehuda omer: echad kotev lannasi, veechad kotev lahedyot. ma ben kotev lannasi lakkotev lahedyot? shehakkotev lannasi en tzarich lezakkot, lahedyot tzarich lezakkot. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze tzerichin lezakkot, lo dibberu benasi ella bahove. rabbi yehuda omer: en anshe galil tzerichin lichtov, shekkevar katvu avotehen al yedehen.
Gemara ammay mittesar? amar rav sheshet, hachi katane: uma takkanatan — yichtevu chelkan lannasi.

Rabbi yehuda omer: echad kotev lannasi veechad kotev lahedyot, uma ben kotev lannasi lechotev lahedyot? hakkotev lannasi en tzarich lezakkot, vehakkotev lahedyot tzarich lezakkot. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze — tzerichim lezakkot, lo dibberu benasi ella bahove.

Rabbi yehuda omer: en anshe galil tzerichin lezakkot, shekkevar katvu avotehen al yedehen. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: anshe galil kanteranin hayu, vehayu nodrin hanaa ze mizze, amdu avotehem vechatvu chelkehen lannasi.

Mishna hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal — notno leacher leshum mattana, vehalla muttar bah. maase beechad bevet choron shehaya aviv noder hemennu hanaa, vehaya massi et beno. veamar lachavero: chatzer useuda netunim hinnan lefanecha, ella kede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu bisuda.

Amar: im shelli hem — hare hem mukedashin lashshamayim. amar lo: natatti lecha et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim?! amar lo: natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavich ochlin veshotin umitratztzin ze laze, vihe avon taluy berosho. amru chachamim: kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah tehe mekuddeshet — enah mattana.
Gemara maase listor! chassore michassera vehachi katane: veim hochiach sofo al techillato — asur. umaase name bevet choron beechad, dahava sofo mochiach al techillato.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella deamar leh "vehinnan lefanecha ella kede sheyyavo abba". aval amar leh: "sheyyehu lefanecha, sheyyavo abba" — "middatecha" hu deamar leh.

Lishshana acharina: amrin la, amar rava: la tema tama deamar leh "vehinnan lefanecha" hu deasur, aval amar leh "hen lefanecha sheyyavo abba veyochal" — muttar. ella afillu amar leh "hen lefanecha yavo abba veyochal" — asur. may tama — seudato mochachat alav.
b: Hahu gavra dahava leh bera dahava shamet kippe dechittana. asrinhu lenichseh aleh. amru leh: vei havay bar berach tzureba merabbanan, may? amar lehon: likne haden, vei havay bar beri tzureba merabbanan, likneyeh. may?
Amri pumebditae: "keni al menat lehakenot" hu, vechol "keni al menat lehakenot" — la kane.
Verav nachman amar: kane, deha sudara "kane al menat lehakenot" hu.

Amar rav ashe: uman lema lan desudara i tafes leh la mittefis? veod: "sudara kane al menat lehakenot vekane min hasheta". halen nichsin dehaden leimatti kane — lechi have bar bereh tzureba merabbanan, lechi hava — hadar sudara lemareh!
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: veha mattenat bet choron "dikni al menat lehakenot" hu, vela ka kane!
Zimnin amar leh: mishshum disudato mochachat alav, vezimnin amar leh rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: afillu vittur asur bemuddar hanaa.
Tenan, amru chachamim: kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah tehe mekuddeshet — enah mattana. "kol" leetoye may? lav leetoye ha milleta deshadya bechippe? la, leetoye lishshana batraa dishmateh derava.
Haderan alach hashshuttafin

a: Hannoder min hamevushshal — muttar betzali uveshaluk. amar: "kuvnnam tavshil sheeni toem" — asur bemaase kedera rach, umuttar beave, umuttar bevetza tormota uvaddallaat harmutza. hannoder mimmaase kedera — en asur ella mimmaase retachta, amar: "kuvnnam hayyored likdera sheeni toem — asur bechol hammitbashshelin bikdera.
Gemara tanya: rabbi yoshiyya oser, veaf al pi sheen reaya ledavar — zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vayvashshelu et happesach baesh kammishpat".
Lema beha kamippalgi, derabbi yoshiyya savar: hallech achar leshon tora, vetanna dilan savar: bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam?

La, dechulle alma bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. beatra detanna dilan — letzali karu leh tzali, velimvushshal karu leh mevushshal. beatra derabbi yoshiyya — afillu tzali karu mevushshal.
Veha kera nasev la! asmachta bealma.
Kuvnnam tavshil kulei. veha mittavshil nedar!

Amar abbaye: hay tanna kol midde demitachel beh rifta — tavshil karu leh. vehatanya: hannoder min hattavshil — asur bechol mine tavshil, veasur betzali uveshaluk uvimvushshal, veasur behitriyyot rakkot shehacholin ochlin bahen pittan.
Ini?! veha rabbi yirmeya chalash, al legabbeh hahu asya leassoye, chaza kara demachet beveteh, shavkeh unefak. amar: malach mota it leh leden beveteh, vaana eul leassaa yateh?!

La kashya: ha — berakkiche, ha — beashshune. rava bar ulla amar: ha — bekara gufeh, veha — begavvevy dikra. deamar rav yehuda: lulibba dekara besilka, lulibba dechittana bechuttacha. vedavar ze asur leomro bifne am haaretz.
Rava amar: man cholin — rabbanan. rava letameh, deamar rava:
b: Keman metzallinan al ketzire veal merie [keman — kerabbi yose]. middeamar ketzire umerie, shema minna: ketzire — ketzire mammash, merie — rabbanan.
Umuttar beava. matnitin dela kevavlae, deamar rabbi zera: bavlae tafshae, deachli lachma belachma.

Amar rav chisda: dimshael lehon lehalen nakdane dehutzal: haden dayysa, hechen mealle lemechla? dechitte — belachma dechitte, vedisare — belachma disare, o dilma: dechitte — bedisare, vedisare — bidchitte?

Rava achleh bachasise. rabba bar rav huna ashkecheh lerav huna dekaachel dayysa beetzbeateh. amar leh: ammay kaachel mar bideh? amar leh: hachi amar rav: dayysa beetzbeata besim, vechol dechen betarten, vechol dechen bitlat.

Amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh, vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: mezammenim lach lemechal dayysa ad parsa. lemechal bisra detora ad telata parsin. amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh, vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: kol middaam la tiflot kammeh rabbach, levar min kara vedayysa, shehen domin liftilta shel avar, vaafillu kamme shabbur malka pelot.

Rabbi yose verabbi yehuda, chad achel dayysa beetzbeateh vechad achel behutza. amar leh deachel behutza lidachel beetzbeateh: ad matay atta maachileni tzoatcha! amar leh deachel beetzbeateh lidachel behutza: ad matay atta maachileni rukkecha!

Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon ayyto lekammayyhu belusefiyn. rabbi yehuda achal, rabbi shimon la achal. amar leh rabbi yehuda: may tama la achel mar? amar leh rabbi shimon: ellu en yotzin mibbene meayim kol ikkar. amar leh rabbi yehuda: kol shekken shennismoch alehen lemachar.

Rabbi yehuda hava yatev kammeh derabbi tarfon. amar leh rabbi tarfon: hayyom panecha tzehubbin. amar leh: emesh yatzu avadecha lassade, veheviu lanu teradin, vaachalnum belo melach. veim achalnum bemelach — kol shekken shehayu panenu tzehubbin.

Amara hahi matronita lerabbi yehuda: more verave? amar la: hemanuta bida dehahi itteta, i taemna ella kiddusha veavdalta vearbea kase defischa, vechograni tziday min happesach ad haatzeret, ella: "chochmat adam tair panav".

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yehuda: panecha domin i kemalve ribbit i kimgaddele chazirin. amar leh: bihudae tarvayyhu asiran. ella — esrim vearbaa bet hakkisse it li min beta ad be midresha, vechol shaa veshaa ani nichnas lechol echad veechad.
Rabbi yehuda kad azel leve midresha shakel gulepa al katpeh, amar: gedola melacha shemmechabbedet et bealeha. rabbi shimon shakel tzanna al katpeh, amar: gedola melacha shemmechabbedet et bealeha.

Devethu derabbi yehuda nefakat, nekatat amra, avada gelima dehuteve. kad nefakat leshuka mikkasseya beh, vechad nafek rabbi yehuda letzalloye hava mikkasse umetzalle. vechad mikkasse beh hava mevarach "baruch sheatani meil".
Zimna chada gezar rabban shimon ben gamliel taanita, rabbi yehuda la ata leve taanita. amrin leh: la it leh kissuya. shaddar leh gelima vela kabbel.

a: Dalli tzippeta vaamar leh lishlucha: chazi may ikka. mihu, la nicha li deithane behaden alma.
Rabbi akiva itkaddashat leh beratte (devar) dechalba savua. shema (bar) kalba savua, addera hanaa mikkol nichseh. azala veitnesiva leh.

Besitva hava ganu be tivna, hava ka menakket lay tivna min mazzeyay. amar la: i havay li, ramena lich yerushalayim dedahava. ata eliyyahu iddemi lehon keenasha veka kare abbava. amar lehu: havu li pureta detivna diledat itteti, velet li middaam leagnoya. amar la rabbi akiva leinteteh: chazi gavra daafillu tivna la it leh.

Amara leh: zil heve be rav. azal tarte sere shenin kamme derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua. lemishlam tarte sere shenin ka ata leveteh, shema min achore beteh dekaamar la chad rasha lidvethu: shappir aved lich avuch chada dela dame lich. veod: [shavkich] armelut chayyut kullehon shenin. amara leh: i tzaet ledili — leheve tarte sere shenin achranyayta. amar: hoil vihavat li reshuta, ehdar laachoray. hadar azal hava tarte sere shene achranyayta.

Ata beesrin vearbea alfin zuge talmide. nefuk kulle alma leappeh, veaf hi kamat lemippak leappeh. amar la hahu rashshia: veat lehecha? amara leh: "yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto". atat leitchazoye leh, ka medachin la rabbanan. amar lehon: hannichu lah, shelli veshellachem shellah hu. shema (bar) kalba savua, ata veitteshil al nidreh veishterayy, veishteri.
Min shet mille iattar rabbi akiva: min kalba savua, min ayyala disfinta. dechol sefinata avdin leh min ayna. zimna chada ansheyu al kef yamma ata hu, ashkecheh.

Umin gevoza, dezimna chada yehev arbaa zuze lesafonae, amar lehu: ayyte li middaam, vela ashkachu ella gevoza al kef yamma. atyu leh. amaru leh: aved marana aleh, ishtechach dahava mele dinare. dezimna chada tevaat sefinta, vechulle iska hava machet behahu gevoza, veishtechach behahu zimna.
Demin disrukita, umin matronita,
b: Umin ishto shel toranuserufus, umin ketia bar shalom.
Rav gammada yehev arbaa zuzi lesafonae leetoye behon middaam. la ashkachu, atyu leh behon kofa. ishtemit al lecharta, chafaru batreh, ashkechu dirvia al margalyayta, ayyeytinnun leh kullehon.

Amara leh bat kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: tora mefoara, bichli mechoar. amar la: limdi mibbet avuch, bamme mannichin yayin? amara leh: bemane defachra. amar la: kulle alma befachra, veattun bemane defachra?! attun achitun bemane dechaspa vedahava!
Azalat uremat chamra bemane dechaspa vedahava, useri. amar la: af orayyta ken. vehaikka shappirin ugemirin! amar la: i havo senu, havo gemirin tefe.

Hahi deatya lekammeh derav yehuda minnehardea ledina veitchayyayvat min dina. amara leh: shemuel rabbach hachi danan?! amar la: yadat leh? amara leh: in, gutztza verabba kereseh ukkam verabba shinneh. amar la: levazzoyeh kaatet? tehve hahi itteta beshamta. pekaa umita.

Umuttar bevetza tormita. may betza tormita? amar shemuel: avda deaved la shave alpa dinare, umeayyel la alpa zimne bemayya chammime vealpa zimne bemayya karire ad demitzutera ki hechi devala yata, veim it keva — sarech ala, vechad nafka veatya, yada asya may samma mitbee leh uvemay mittassi.
Shemuel hava badek nafsheh bekulecha, ad dimsatterin inashe beteh aleh sarehon.
Tenan hatam: haya ose bichlufesin — lo yochal bivnot sheva. bivnot sheva — lo yochal bichlufesin. may kelufesin? mina ditene deavdin minnehon lafde.
Hahu gavra dihav avda lechavreh leagmoreh alpa mine lafde, agmereh tamne mea. azmeneh ledina lekammeh derabbi. amar rabbi: avotenu amru "nashinu tova", anu afillu beenenu lo rainu.

Rabbi avad leh hillula lerabbi shimon berabbi, ketav al bet genana: esrin vearbea alfin ribboin dinarin nefaku al bet genana den, vela azmeneh levar kappara. amar leh: im leovre retzono kach — leose retzono al achat kamma vechamma. azmeneh, amar: leose retzono baolam hazze kach — laolam habba al achat kamma vechamma.
Yoma dimchayyech beh rabbi, atya pureanuta lealma. amar leh levar kappara: la tevaddeychan veyahevna lach arbein gerive chitte. amar leh: lichze mar

a: Dechol geriva devaena shakelna. shekal dikkula rabba, chafyeh kufera vesachfeh al resheh, vaazal vaamar leh: lechil li mar arbein gerive chitte derashena bach. achuch rabbi. amar leh: lav azhartacha dela tevaddechan? amar leh: chitte derashena ka nasevna.
Amar la bar kappara levarteh derabbi: limchar shatena chamra berikkuda daavuch uvekirkane deimmich. ben elasa chatneh derabbi hava, veashir gadol hava. azmeneh leve hillula derabbi shimon berabbi.

Amar leh bar kappara lerabbi: may "toeva"? kol daamar leh rabbi dehachen hu "toeva", parcha bar kappara. amar leh: parsheh at. amar leh: tete devetchi tirme li natla. atat ramya leh. amar leh lerabbi: kum rekod li, deemar lach: hachi amar rachamana: "toeva" — toe atta bah.
Lechasa acharina amar leh: may "tevel"? amar leh ki inyayna kadmaa. amar leh: ived li deomar lach. avad. amar leh: "tevel hu" — tavlin yesh bah. mi shanya hada bia min kullehon biot?
Amar leh: umay "zimma"? amar leh: ived ki inyayna kadmaa. avad vaamar leh: zo ma hi. la yechel ben elasa lemisbal, kam unefak hu veinteteh mittamman.
May ben elasa? detanya: lo lechinnam pizzer ben elasa et meotav, ella lehareot bahen tisporet shel kohen gadol.

Dichtiv: "kasom yichsemu et rashehem". tana: keen luleyanit. may "luleyanit"? amar rav yehuda: tispurta yechidta. hechi dame? amar rava: rosho shel ze betzad ikkaro shel ze. vehayeynu tisporet shel kohen gadol.
Uvaddallaat harmutza. may "dallaat harmutza"? amar shemuel: kara karkuzay. rav ashe amar: dallaat hattemuna beremetz.
Etiveh ravina lerav ashe, rabbi nechemya omer: dallaat arammit hi dallaat hammitzrit, kilayim im hayyevanit, kilayim im harmutza. teyuveta.
Mishna hannoder mimmaase kedera — en asur ella mimmaase retachta. amar "kuvnnam hayyored likdera sheani toem" — asur bechol hannaase bikdera.

Gemara tanya: hannoder min hayyored likdera — asur bayyored leilpas, shekkevar yarad likdera kodem sheyyorad leilpas. min hayyored leilpas — muttar beyored likdera. min hannaase bikdera — muttar benaase beilpas. min hannaase beilpas — muttar benaase bikdera.
Hannoder min hayyored letannur — en asur ella befat. veim amar: "kol maase tannur alay" — asur bechol hannaasim betannur.
b: Mishna "min hakkavush" — en asur ella min hakkavush shel yarak. "kavush sheani toem" — asur bechol hakkevushim. "min hashshaluk" — eno asur ella min hashshaluk shel basar. "shaluk sheani toem" — asur bechol hashshelukim.
Gemara amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: amar "dichvish", may? "dishlik", may? "ditzli", may? "dimliach", may? hechen mashma? tibbee.

Mishna "min hatztzali" — en asur ella min hatztzali shel basar, divre rabbi yehuda. "tzali sheani toem" — asur bechol hatztzeluyim. "min hammaliach" — en asur ella min hammaliach shel dag. "maliach sheani toem" — asur bechol hammeluchim.

"Dag dagim sheani toem" — asur bahen, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ben meluchim ben tefelim, ben chayyim ben mevushshalim, umuttar betarit terufa, uvetzir. hannoder min hatztzachana — asur betarit terufa, umuttar betzir uvemureyays. hannoder mittarit terufa — asur betzir uvemureyays.

Gemara tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: "dag sheani toem" — asur bigdolim, umuttar biktannim. "daga sheani toem" — asur biktannim umuttar bigdolim. "dag daga sheani toem" — asur ben bigdolim ben biktannim.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: mimmay dedag sheani toem" — gadol hu, dichtiv: "vayman Adonai dag gadol livloa et yona". vehachtiv: "vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga"!

Ha la kashya: dilma palteh dag gadol, uvaleh dag katan. ella: "vehaddaga asher bayor meta", ketannim metu, gedolim lo metu?! ella: "daga" — mashma gedolim umashma ketannim, uvindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam.
Hannoder min hatztzachana kulei. amar leh ravina lerav ashe, amar: "hare alay tzichin", may? tibbee.
Mishna hannoder min hechalav — muttar bakkom, verabbi yose oser. min hakkom — muttar bechalav. abba shaul omer: hannoder min haggevina — asur bah, ben melucha utefela. hannoder min habbasar —

a: Muttar barotev uvakkefe, verabbi yehuda oser.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase veasar alenu rabbi tarfon bevetzim shennitbashshelu immo. amru lo: ken haddavar, ematay — bizman sheyyomar: "basar ze alay", shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher, im yesh bo benoten taam — asur.
Hannoder min hayyayin — muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin. amar: "kuvnnam yayin ze sheani toem" venafal letavshil, im yesh bo benoten taam — hare ze asur.
b: Gemara ureminhu: "min" haadashim" — asur baashishim, verabbi yose mattir.
La kashya: mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. beatra derabbanan karu lachalava chalava ulekoma koma, beatreh derabbi yose lekoma name karu leh "koma dachalava".

Tanya: hannoder min hechalav — muttar bakkom, min hakkom — muttar bechalav. min hechalav — muttar bigvina, min haggevina — muttar bechalav. min harotev — muttar bekefe, min hakkefe — muttar berotev. im amar "basar ze alay" — asur bo uverotbo uvekefo.
Hannoder min hayyayin — muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin. amar: "kuvnnam yayin ze sheeni toem" venafal letoch hattavshil, im yesh bo taam yayin — hare ze asur.
Mishna hannoder min haanavim — muttar beyayin. min hazzetim — muttar beshemen. amar "kuvnnam zetim vaanavim ellu sheeni toem" — asur bahen uveyotze mehen.
Gemara bae rame bar chama: "ellu" davka, o "sheeni toem" davka?
I salka datach "ellu" davka, "sheeni toem" lema li? ha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav deamar "sheeni toem", i deamar "ellu" — mittesar, vei la — la.
Amar rava, ta shema: "kuvnnam perot haellu alay", "kuvnnam hen lefi" — asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, ha bayyotze mehen muttar!
Hu haddin daafillu beyotze mehen asur. veha adifa leh leashmoinan dechillufehen kegiddulehen dame.
Ta shema: "sheeni ochel", vesheeni toem" — muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. ha hayyotze mehen — asur! ayyeyde dela nasev beresha "yotze mehen", la nasev name besefa "yotze mehen".

Ta shema, amar rabbi yehuda: maase veasar rabbi tarfon alay betzim shennitbashshelu immo. amru lo: ematay, bizman sheamar "basar ze alay", shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher, veyesh bo benoten taam — hare ze asur.
Beellu" — la ka mibbaya lan dedavka hu. ki mibbaya lan besheeni toem" — davka, o lav davka?
Ta shema: "dag dagim sheeni toem" — asur bahen, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ben chayyim ben mevushshalim, umuttar betarit terufa uvetzir.
Amar rava: uchevar yatza mehen.

a: Mishna hannoder min hattemarim — muttar bidvash temarim. missitvaniyyot — muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kol sheshshem toladto keruya alav, venoder hemennu — asur bayyotze hemennu, vachachamim mattirim.
Gemara [chachamim] hayeynu tanna kamma?

Ikka benayyhu hada detanya: kelal ze amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol sheddarko leechol, vederech hayyotze mimmennu leechol. kegon temarim udevash temarim, nadar bo — asur bayyotze mimmennu, noder miyyotze mimmennu — asur bo.
Kol sheen darko leechol, vederech hayyotze mimmennu leechol, noder bo — en asur ella bayyotze mimmennu, shello nitkavvevn ze ella layyotze mimmennu.
Mishna hannoder min hayyayin — muttar beyen tappuchim. min hashshemen — muttar beshemen shumeshmin. min haddevash — muttar bidvash temarim.
Min hachometz — muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. min hakkereshin — muttar bekaflotot. min hayyarak — muttar beyarkot hassade, shehu shem lavuyy.

Gemara tanya: hannoder min hashshemen, beeretz yisrael — muttar beshemen shumeshmin, veasur beshemen zayit. uvevavel — asur beshemen shumeshmin, umuttar beshemen zayit. makom shemmistappekin mizze umizze — asur baze uvaze.
Peshita! la tzericha, derubba min chad mistappekin. mahu detema: ezil batar rubba, ka mashma lan safek issura lechumera.

Hannoder min hayyarak, bishar shene shavua — asur beyarkot hagginna, umuttar beyarkot hassade. uvashsheviit — asur beyarkot hassade, umuttar beyarkot hagginna. amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel:
b: Lo shanu ella bimkom sheen meviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz. aval bemakom shemmeviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz — asur.
Ketannae: en meviin yarak min chutza laaretz laaretz, rabbi chananya ben gamliel omer: meviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz. may tameh deman deamar en meviin? amar rabbi yirmeya: mishshum gush.
Mishna min hakkeruv — asur beispargos, min haispargos — muttar bichruv.
Min haggerisin — asur bemikpa, verabbi yose mattir. min hammikpa — muttar bigrisin. min hammikpa — asur bishshum, verabbi yose mattir. min hashshum — muttar bemikpa.
Min haadashim — asur baashishim, rabbi yose mattir. min haashishim — muttar baadashim.

"Chitta chittin sheani toem" — asur bahen ben kemach ben happat. "geris gerisin sheani toem" — asur bahen ben chayyin ben mevushshalin. rabbi yehuda omer: "kuvnnam geris o chitta sheani toem" — muttar lachos chayyim.

Gemara tanya rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer: "chitta sheani toem" — asur leefot umuttar lachos. "chittim sheani toem" — asur lachos umuttar leefot. "chitta chittin sheani toem" — asur ben lachos ben leefot.
"Geris sheani toem" — asur levashshel umuttar lachos. "gerisin sheani toem" — asur lachos umuttar levashshel. "geris gerisin sheani toem" — asur ben levashshel ben lachos.
Hadaran alach hannoder min hamevushshal

a: Hannoder min hayyarak — muttar baddilluin, verabbi akiva oser. amru lo lerabbi akiva: vahalo omer adam lishlucho "kach li yarak", vehu omer: "lo matzati ella dilluin".
Amar lahem: ken haddavar, o shemma omer hu "lo matzati ella kitnit"? ella, shehaddilluin bichlal yarak, vekitnit eno bichlal yarak. veasur befol hammitzri lach, umuttar bayyavesh.
Gemara hannoder min hayyarak kulei. veha min yarak nedar! amar ulla: beomer "yarke kedera alay", vedilma yarak hanneechol bikdera kaamar? beomer "yarak hammitbashshel bikdera alay".

Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbanan savri: kol milleta ditzrich shelicha leimmeloche ala — lav mineh hu. verabbi akiva savar: kol milleta demimmelich shelicha ala — mineh hu. amar abbaye: mode rabbi akiva leinyan malkot, sheeno loke.
Tenan hatam: hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto — baal habbayit maal. lo asa shelichuto — shaliach maal.

Man tanna? amar rav chisda: matnitin dela kerabbi akiva, ditnan: ketzad? amar lo: "ten basar laorchim" venatan lahem kaved, "ten kaved" venatan lahem basar — hashshaliach maal. vei rabbi akiva, ha amar rabbi akiva: kol milleta demimmelich ala shaliach — mineh hu, limol baal habbayit vela limol shaliach!
Amar abbaye: afillu tema rabbi akiva,
b: Mi la mode rabbi akiva ditzrich immeloche? ittemar shemata kammeh derava. amar lehon: shappir amar nachmani.

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva — rabban shimon ben gamliel hi. detanya: hannoder min habbasar — asur bechol mine vasar, veasur barosh uvaraglayim uvakkane uvakkaved uvallev, uveofot, umuttar bivsar dagim vachagavim.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hannoder min habbasar — asur bechol mine vasar, umuttar barosh uvaraglayim uvakkane uvakkaved uvallev uveofot, veen tzarich lomar besar dagim vachagavim. vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: keravayim lav basar, veochlehen lav bar inash. ochlehen kevasar, leinyan zevine — lav bar inash.

May shena besar of letanna kamma daasir — daavid shelicha demimmelich aleh. besar dagim name aved shelicha, dei la mashkach bisra, mimmelich aleh, deamar: i la mashkachna bisra ayyte dagim, velittasru!

Amar abbaye: kegon shehikkiz dam, dela achel dagim. i hachi, afillu ofot name la achel. deamar shemuel: dimsochar veachel bisra detzippera — parach libbeh ketzippera! vetanya: en makkizin lo al dagim, velo al ofot, velo al basar maliach. vetanya: hikkiz dam — lo yochal lo chalav, velo gevina, velo betzim, velo shachalayim, velo ofot, velo basar maliach! shane ofot, deefshar al yede shelika.
Abbaye amar: kegon dechayyvin leh eneh, dedagim kashin laenayim. i hachi achel dagim, deha amar shemuel: nun samech ayin — nuna samma leenayim! hahu sof uchela.

a: Mishna hannoder min haddagan — asur befol hammitzri yavesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: eno asur ella bachameshet hamminin. rabbi meir omer: hannoder min hattevua — eno asur ella mechameshet hamminin. aval hannoder min haddagan — asur bakkol, umuttar beferot hailan uvayyarak.

Gemara lememra dedagan" — kol demiddegan mashma. metiv rav yosef: "vechifrotz haddavar hirbu vene yisrael [reshit] dagan tirosh veyitzhar vechol tevuat sade larov vegomer", vei amrat dagan — kol demiddegan mashma, may "kifrotz haddavar hirbu"? amar abbaye: leetoye perot hailan veyarak.

Rabbi meir omer: hannoder min hattevua vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim benoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin. tanya name hachi: shavin bannoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin. peshita! mahu detema: "tevua" — kol mille mashma, kamashma lan dela mashma kol milli.
Metiv rav yosef: "vechifrotz haddavar hirbu vene yisrael kulei", amar rava: "tevua" lechud, "tevuat sade" lechud.

Bar mar shemuel pakked delittenun telesar alfe zuzi lerava min alalta dinhar panya. shalcha rava lekammeh derav yosef: "alalta" hechi mikkarya? amar rav yosef, matnitin hi: veshavin bannoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin. amar leh abbaye: mi dame? "tevua" — la mashma ella mechameshet hamminin, "alalta" — kol mille mashma.

Ahderuhu lekammeh derava. amar: ha la ka mibbaya li daalalta" kol mille mashma. hada hu deibbaya li: sechar battim usechar sefinot may? mi amrinan: kevan defachatan, lav alalta hi. o dilma: kevan dela yedia pechatayyhu — alalta hi. amruha rabbanan kammeh derav yosef, amar: vechi meachar dela tzerich lan, ammay shelach lan? ikkefad rav yosef.

Shema rava, vaata lekammeh bemaale yoma dechippure. ashkecheh leshammaeh dahava ka mazeg kammeh kasa dechamra. amar leh: hav li deemzig leh ana. yehav leh, veka mazeg ihu kasa dechamra. ki ka shate amar: haden mizga dame lemizga derava bereh derav yosef bar chama. amar leh: hu nihu.
Amar leh: la tittev akkarach ad deamrat li perusha dehaden milleta: may dichtiv: "umimmidbar mattana umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot"?

Amar leh: kevan sheose adam et atzmo kammidbar, shehu mufekar lakkol — tora nittena lo bemattana, shenneemar: "umimmidbar mattana". vechevan shennittena lo bemattana — nechalo el, shenneemar: "umimmattana nachaliel". vechevan shennechalo el — ole ligdulla, shenneemar: "uminnachaliel bamot". veim higbiah atzmo — hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo, shenneemar: "umibbamot haggay", velo od ella sheshshokin oto bakkarka, shenneemar: "venishkafa al pene hayeshimon". veim chozer bo — hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho
b: Shenneemar: "kol ge yinnase".

Tanya: hannoder min haddagan — asur af befol hammitzri yavesh, umuttar ballach. umuttar beorez, bechilka, betargis uvetisne. hannoder min perot hashshana — asur bechol perot hashshana, umuttar bigdayim uvitlaim uvechalav uvevetzim uvegozalot. veim amar "giddule shana alay" — asur bechullan.
Hannoder min perot haaretz — asur bechol perot haaretz, umuttar bichmehin ufitriyyot. veim amar "giddule karka alay" — asur bechullan.

Ureminhi: al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz — omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", vetanya: al hammelach veal hazzamit veal kemehin ufitriyyot — omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". amar abbaye: mirba ravu meara, menak meavvera yanki vela meara. veha katane "al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz"! teni: al davar sheen yonek min haaretz.
Mishna hannoder min hakkesut muttar besak, uviria, uvachamila. amar: "kunnam tzemer ole alay" — muttar lehitkassot begizze tzemer. "happishtan ole alay" — muttar lehitkassot baanitze pishtan.
Rabbi yehuda omer, hakkol lefi hannoder: taan vehizzia vehaya recho kashe, amar: "kunnam tzemer ufishtim ole alay" — muttar lehitkassot, veasur lehafeshil laachorav.

Gemara tanya: hannoder min hakkesut — muttar besak uviria uvachamila, veasur befuneda uvifsikya uviskuretya uvekatavulya veanpilya ufelinya umichnasayim vechova. may "iskurete"? amar rabba bar chana: kittuna detzalla.

Tanya: yotzin besak ave uvesagos ave uviria uvachamila mippene haggeshamim, aval lo beteva velo bekuppa velo bemachtzelet mippene haggeshamim. haroim yotzin besakkim. velo roim bilvad amru, ella kol adam, ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove.

Rabbi yehuda omer hakkol lefi hannoder kulei. tanya: ketzad amar rabbi yehuda hakkol lefi hannoder? haya lavush tzemer vehetzar, veamar "kunnam tzemer ole alay" — asur lilbosh umuttar liton. haya taun pishtan vehizzia, veamar: "kunnam pishtan ole alay" — muttar lilbosh veasur liton.
